finalText:
Build's clean now (exit 0, 0 errors). The huge scroll of deprecation/dedupe noise was harmless, but two real bugs from the bump were buried in it:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the bumped bundler now passes options as `{ retryCount }` instead of `{ retries }`; `resolveRetries` was still reading the old field, so it crashed calling `.toFixed()` on `undefined`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`; `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on `undefined`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled (matching old default behavior).
